title: A uniformizer generates the differentials at a separable smooth curve point
statement: Let $k$ be a field, let $X$ be a separated integral scheme of finite type over $k$ of dimension one [def-pc-curve], smooth over $k$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], and let $x\in X$ be a closed point whose residue field $\kappa(x)$ is a finite separable extension of $k$ [def-weil-residue-field, def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension]. The local ring $A=\mathcal O_{X,x}$ is a discrete valuation ring [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring]. For every uniformizer $t\in A$, the $A$-module $\Omega_{A/k}$ of Kähler differentials, with its universal derivation $d:A\to\Omega_{A/k}$ [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials], is free of rank one with basis $dt$; equivalently $A\to\Omega_{A/k}$, $a\mapsto a\,dt$, is an isomorphism.

proof.text: Apply [lem-a1-smooth-curve-closed-stalk-structure] to the given smooth integral curve and closed point. It gives that $A=\mathcal O_{X,x}$ is a Noetherian discrete valuation ring and that $\Omega_{A/k}$ is free of rank one. By [def-weil-residue-field], the induced residue extension $A/\mathfrak m$ is exactly $\kappa(x)/k$, so it is finite separable by the hypotheses. This proves the first assertion and supplies all local-ring and module hypotheses for the next step.

source.place: Tag 0C1E, lemma-uniformizer-works, first and last proof sentences: the DVR assertion and rank-one differential module; old Steps 1–3 of lem-a1-uniformizer-differential-basis, including both dimension conventions

proof.text: Apply [lem-a1-dvr-separable-residue-differential-basis] to this $k$-algebra $A$. For each uniformizer $t$ its conclusion gives the isomorphism $A\to\Omega_{A/k}$, $b\mapsto b\,dt$, with explicit inverse in any rank-one basis. Thus $dt$ freely generates $\Omega_{A/k}$. The lemma quantifies over every generator of $\mathfrak m$, so this holds for every uniformizer as required.

lean.statement: theorem uniformizer_differential_basis (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsIntegralCurve f] [Smooth f] (x : X) (hx : IsClosed ({x} : Set X)) (hfinite : (f.residueFieldAlgebraMap x).Finite) (hsep : @Algebra.IsSeparable k (X.residueField x) _ _ (f.residueFieldAlgebraMap x).toAlgebra) : IsDiscreteValuationRing (X.presheaf.stalk x) ∧ ∀ t : X.presheaf.stalk x, IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x) = Ideal.span {t} → Function.Bijective (fun a : X.presheaf.stalk x ↦ a • @KaehlerDifferential.D k (X.presheaf.stalk x) _ _ (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ f.appTop ≫ X.presheaf.germ ⊤ x trivial).hom.toAlgebra) t)
